testing/generation#

Generators of test values for property tests, with shrinking.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let numbers = IntegerGeneration(minimum: -1000, maximum: 1001);     // -1000..1000
let lists = SequenceGeneration(origin: numbers, minimum: 0, maximum: 20);

Description#

Generators of test values for property tests, with shrinking.

A generated value knows smaller values to try when a property fails.

object IntegerGeneration#

object IntegerGeneration does Generation<int>

Integer bounds are half-open, just like Randomizing.integer(). Size bounds distance from the nearest admissible zero. Exact rat arithmetic avoids int overflow while calculating windows and midpoint reductions at int64 limits.

IntegerGeneration.IntegerGeneration#

IntegerGeneration(minimum is int, maximum is int)

Integers from minimum up to, not including, maximum.

IntegerGeneration.sample#

sample(random is Randomizing, size is int) is Generated<int>

An integer no farther than size from the value nearest 0; it shrinks toward that value.

object SequenceGeneration#

object SequenceGeneration<T> does Generation<Sequencing<T>>

Inclusive length bounds. Size controls distance from the minimum; each element receives the same size and the caller's random stream, in order.

SequenceGeneration.SequenceGeneration#

SequenceGeneration(origin is Generation<T>, minimum is int, maximum is int)

An array; size bounds how far its length goes past minimum.
